`runScheduled()` in `src/exports/scheduler.ts` now logs progress with `console.log`. I haven't run it or type-checked it.

- **Start:** it logs `[scheduler] starting job <id>` before each export.
- **Finish:** it logs `[scheduler] finished job <id>: <url> (<n> jobs left)` after each export. `<n>` is the number of jobs still in the queue.

I used `console.log` because I didn't check whether the project has a logger. If it does, I can switch the calls over.
